name: University of Tennessee at Chattanooga
academic_ranking: Regional public university (University of Tennessee system). Mid-size doctoral/research institution with roughly 11,000 students; moderately selective admissions. Specific ranking not verified from an authoritative source during research.
financial_aid: Public university offering both in-state and out-of-state tuition rates; standard federal/state aid, need- and merit-based scholarships available through UTC. Specific USD tuition figure not confirmed from an authoritative source during research (staff/bursar pages returned 404 and third-party sites resolved to other Tennessee schools).
facilities_notes: Softball competes at the on-campus facility within the UTC athletics complex (gomocs.com). Facility page not accessible during research; no verified details captured.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I program competing in the Southern Conference (SoCon). Detailed championship/NCAA appearance history not verified from an authoritative source during research.
notes: Data collected from gomocs.com softball coaches and roster pages, fetched 2026-07-30. Coaching staff and support staff reflect the 2026 directory.
